reviewer_statement: Developer-side six-domain full native-language semantic review of frozen Python 1.2 typed participant/trial random-effect frame sources. Direct source dataclass and pandas cell-by-cell fixtures and matching native R schema; exact error boundary and nullable predictor. The dataclass/pandas class identities cannot be preserved across native R, and arbitrary Python custom object protocols are outside this mapping. Not independently certified and exact-head CI pending.
native_language_semantic_policy: Source Python FunctionalMixedEffectsResult typed record is represented by a validated native R source-shaped list or fitted native S3 model; pandas output by R data.frame. The scientific conditional effect estimand, units, source order, provenance and values are preserved. Cross-language class identity and exception class identity are not claimed.

case_evidence.description: Source typed FunctionalMixedEffectsResult and native R record counterparts, with intercept/slope selector and trial intercept prerequisite
Participant and trial functions on observed finite time grids, native source IDs, nullable optional random-slope predictor, no hidden group averaging
Per-participant and per-trial conditional random-effect values and zero-based trial curve indices matched source cell-by-cell
Reject absent random functional slope, invalid effect selection, missing trial intercept, nonfinite random-effect matrix and invalid native geometry
Exactly six participant columns and eight nested-trial columns, correct source-major ordering and nullable predictor
Fitted conditional participant and trial functional random effects (BLUPs); no new model estimation, smoothing or imputation

independent_review_status: developer-reviewed only; independent review and exact-head multi-OS frozen Python qualification pending
language_specific_limits: Python typed dataclass is represented by native list/S3 with validation
Python pandas DataFrame is represented by native R data.frame
Semantic error conditions do not imply identical Python exception class identity
